about.p3: I'm currently in my final year of the Systems Analyst degree, which gives me a unique perspective: I can speak the same language as developers and stakeholders, bridging the gap between design and development.

items.title: Personal Finance App
items.description: Complete redesign of a financial management app. User research, wireframes, interactive prototype and design system in Figma.
items.overview: This project consisted of the complete redesign of a personal finance mobile application. The main goal was to improve the user experience by simplifying complex flows and creating a modern, accessible visual interface that allows users to manage their finances intuitively.
items.challenge: The original app had confusing navigation, information-overloaded screens, and a high drop-off rate in the registration flow. Users reported difficulty finding key features such as transaction history and budget settings.
items.solution: A complete restructuring of the information architecture was carried out, main flows were simplified, and a consistent design system was created. Financial data visualization with clear charts was prioritized, and a guided onboarding was implemented for new users.

process.description: Interviews with 12 users, competitive analysis of 5 leading market apps, satisfaction surveys and creation of 3 representative user personas.
Card sorting sessions with real users, new information architecture, optimized user flows and initial sketches of the main screens.
Low and high-fidelity wireframes in Figma, design system with reusable components, accessible color palette and typography optimized for reading on mobile devices.
Usability tests with 8 participants, feedback-based iterations, final interactive prototype and complete design system documentation.

results: Registration flow reduced from 6 to 3 steps
Reorganized information architecture with direct access to the 4 most used features
Design system with over 40 documented components

items.title: E-learning Platform
items.description: Educational platform design from scratch. User interviews, empathy maps, wireframes and high-fidelity prototype.
items.overview: Comprehensive design of an e-learning platform aimed at university students. The project covered everything from initial user research to the delivery of a high-fidelity prototype, with a focus on accessibility and motivation for continuous learning.
items.challenge: Existing educational platforms had overwhelming interfaces, lack of personalization in learning paths, and low student retention. An experience was needed that would motivate continuous learning and adapt to different study styles.
items.solution: A platform was designed with customizable learning paths, a subtle gamification system to maintain motivation, and a clean interface that prioritizes content. A personalized dashboard was implemented that visually shows progress and celebrates achievements.

process.description: In-depth interviews with 15 university students, benchmark of 6 educational platforms, empathy maps and definition of 4 user personas.
Co-creation workshop with students, user experience maps, prioritization of key features using MoSCoW methodology and storyboards of key flows.
Iterative wireframes, design system focused on WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, low and high-fidelity prototypes, and micro-interactions for system feedback.
Remote usability tests with Maze, heatmap analysis, iterations over 3 improvement cycles and final presentation to stakeholders.

results: Complete responsive design for desktop, tablet and mobile
Gamification system with study badges and streaks
Onboarding flow that personalizes the experience in 4 steps
Interactive prototype with over 35 connected screens

items.title: Management Dashboard
items.description: Administration interface for an internal system. Reusable components, responsive design and design system documentation.
items.overview: Design of an internal management dashboard for an organization that needed to centralize metrics, reports and tasks in a single interface. The project focused on creating a clear, efficient and scalable visual system, with a complete design system to facilitate future implementations.
items.challenge: The management team handled information across multiple spreadsheets and disconnected tools. There was no unified view of key metrics, leading to delays in decision-making and errors due to lack of real-time updated data.
items.solution: A modular dashboard was designed with configurable widgets, real-time data visualization, intelligent alerts system and scalable component architecture. Efficiency in recurring tasks and customization by user role were prioritized.

process.description: Interviews with 6 members of the management team, analysis of current workflows, audit of existing tools and identification of main pain points.
Definition of key metrics by role, sketches of modular layouts, information hierarchy definition and feature prioritization with the development team.
Complete design system with atomic components, charts and data visualizations, responsive design for desktop and tablet, and light/dark modes.
Review with the development team to ensure technical feasibility, tests with end users, iterations and complete documentation in Figma.

results: Design system with over 60 documented components
Data visualization system with 8 chart types
Complete documentation with usage guides for the development team
